answers.how: The raccoon is approximately 109 px long and 45 px tall; 1.51 × 45/109 ≈ 0.62.
Near 1.0 s, the raccoon moves approximately 183 px/s. Using 1.51 m per 109 px gives 2.54 m/s.
The raccoon moves approximately 92 px from 0.5 s to 1.0 s; 92 × 1.51/109 ≈ 1.27.
